name: Philadelphia / West Chester KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday in the Brandywine Valley on the West Branch of Brandywine Creek, with a canoe launch and creekside tent sites; RV sites sit on wooded hillside loops above the creek. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: koa.com reserve form (koa.py, KOA backlog quote 2026-10-19, dump audit/koa_backlog_2026-10-19/dumps/philadelphia_05.txt): 1-night stay Tue 05/18/2027 sells 8 RV site types (gravel/grass back-ins and pull-thrus, W/E to 50A full hookup) for a 23-ft motorhome; park page read 2026-10-21 lists Open All Year, 90' max length, no minimum stay; official PDF site map shows ~70 numbered RV sites plus cabins and tent sites, satellite shows RVs on open loops with no seasonal/residential structures -> real transient RV campground; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Re-audit of the booking engine's 'wooded river level sites ... camp near water' claim (W/E NO SEWER type), 2026-10-21: official KOA PDF site map (koa.com/content/campgrounds/philadelphia/sitemap/...pdf) puts Brandywine Creek along the park's SW edge with the 'Riverfront Tent' sites 113-136 and the loop road between it and the nearest RV row (W/E sites 103-110), i.e. a used strip; Esri satellite (sat.py/satz.py at 39.9276,-75.7340 and 39.9282,-75.7351, pixels rendered) shows dense canopy between the cabin/RV rows and the creek (~40-65 m), so no RV pad within a pad-depth of the water and no confirmable sightline; main RV loops are on the hillside ~100 m from the creek (DEM 103 m at the loops vs ~74 m near the creek); no dam involved -> default down
fees_source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/philadelphia/reserve/ via koa.py (KOA backlog, read 2026-10-19), 2 adults, 23-ft motorhome, 1 night Tue 05/18/2027: Back In 30A W/E (Near Pool / NO SEWER) $70.00 avg/night cheapest, up to Pull Thru 50A full-hookup KOA Patio $112.00; before tax; KOA Select My Site +$10 optional; no mandatory per-night fee shown
flags: Waterfront left at not waterfront: the W/E 'river level' RV row (103-110) is behind the loop road and the Riverfront Tent row on the official map and under canopy on satellite; AWH may know whether those sites see the creek (a 10/5/2026 KOA review says 'we stayed by the creek without a sewer hookup').
A 10/2/2026 KOA review with a 41-ft fifth wheel calls Embreeville Rd 'a nightmare with a larger unit' and says GPS showed a 25 ft limit; EKKO at 23 ft is under that.
Fall promo on koa.com (2026): second night 50% off; not a fee change.
